traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements in docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and covered by passing automated tests.
• Core Functionality: Auto-fix for missing @story annotations on functions/methods (require-story-annotation) and for simple @story path suffix issues (valid-annotation-format) is implemented and verified in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts and additional rule tests. • Quality & Safety: Fixers are conservative (suffix-only for paths, insertion of a single JSDoc line before function/method declarations) and avoid modifying runtime code; they abort and fall back to diagnostics when a safe fix cannot be determined. • Integration: Both rules declare meta.fixable, are wired into the plugin configs (validated by plugin-setup tests), and work with ESLint’s `--fix` flow as exercised via RuleTester. • User Experience & Error Handling: Tests demonstrate consistent behavior across multiple AST node types and scenarios, and validators explicitly avoid auto-fix when patterns don’t match or paths are ambiguous (e.g., contain `..`). • Selective Control & Templates: The require-story-annotation rule supports configurable annotationTemplate/methodAnnotationTemplate and an autoFix toggle; valid-annotation-format exposes an autoFix option. Tests confirm that templates are honored and that disabling autoFix prevents edits while retaining diagnostics. • Documentation: user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix capabilities, configuration knobs, and safety constraints for both rules.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted helper functions, rich tests tied directly to this story via @story/@req/@supports tags, and passing test suite, this story is fully implemented.
